experimental_context: Approximately 35% AE4 null reduction; context only, with no fitted target or exact acceptance band. Five percent residual AE4 is not literal genetic zero.
routing_interpretation: Both routing families increase secretion at every calcium. AE4NA05 has the larger median increase, most clearly at 0.10 uM; there is no disagreement in direction.
scientific_interpretation: The AE4 effect is substantial and much larger than the essentially neutral AE2 effect, but all AE4 predictions increase secretion. This frozen 5% AE4 panel does not reproduce the direction of the general experimental secretion loss phenotype.
time_trace_role: Diagnostic only; no detailed time signature acceptance criterion.
